stimulus.text: Dear Ms. Wulan, I am writing to ask for permission to leave school early on Friday. My family is travelling to Probolinggo for my grandfather's 70th birthday.
Our train leaves at 1 p.m., so I need to leave after the third lesson. I will ask my friend to share her notes with me. Yours sincerely, Andika (8C)

items.prompt: Clean & Green Day: Who wrote the announcement?

stimulus.text: ANNOUNCEMENT: Our school will hold a Clean & Green Day on Saturday, 14 March. All students should bring a broom or a small shovel. Each class will plant trees in the front yard.
The cleanest class will win a trip to Kebun Raya Purwodadi. Please wear sports clothes. - Student Council

items.prompt: Tari's letter: Where did Tari most likely live before?

stimulus.text: Dear Nisa, Thanks for your letter! Life in Jakarta is busy, but I miss the quiet mornings in Pacitan. Our new flat is on the 15th floor, so I can see the whole city.
I've joined a photography club and I'm learning to take photos at night. Could you send me a picture of our old beach? Love, Tari

items.reteach: Ia rindu pagi yang tenang di Pacitan dan menyebut "our old beach".

stimulus.text: Hi all, our Grade 9 farewell party will be held in Hall B on 20 June, 6-9 p.m. Each class will perform one act: a song, a dance, or a short drama.
